rule Suspicious_PowerShell_Downloader {
    meta:
        description = "Detects common patterns in malicious PowerShell downloaders"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE T1059.001, T1105"
        maltype = "Downloader"
    strings:
        $webclient = "New-Object Net.WebClient" wide ascii
        $download = "DownloadString" wide ascii
        $invoke = "Invoke-Expression" wide ascii
        $b64 = "-EncodedCommand" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($webclient, $download, $invoke) or $b64
}

arguments.summary: A critical security incident was initiated by a phishing email that delivered a malicious PowerShell script to a finance department workstation (WS-FIN-042). The script executed a Cobalt Strike beacon, establishing command and control (C2) communication with a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23). The compromised account (jsmith@corp.local) was used for lateral movement attempts via SMB. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, resetting user credentials, performing a full endpoint scan, and applying a hardening playbook to the affected host.
